info.title: IST Health Tele-Triage events
info.description: Event types carry the prefix com.irisstar.aimltriage.. Payloads hold references and changed field names, never record contents.

approval.recorded.description: Published when approval.recorded occurs. Delivered as a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope to webhooks, rules and the message broker.
